decisions.reason: As an organic snack that remains close to the core charcuterie business and the stated expansion of organic lines and formats, it has enough strategic fit and accumulated launch effort that management would likely continue it absent clear failure evidence.

This premium salami snack line spans several models and sits squarely within existing capabilities, so sunk merchandising and assortment commitments make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
Having been launched only in 2024 as part of the firm's bio range, it is very likely to be given more time because management can still attribute any weak early results to a normal bedding-in phase.
This multi-model organic chicken-breast line is tightly aligned with the firm's announced organic expansion and has fresh, visible commitment behind it, which strongly favors retention.

The product is a recent organic extension close to the established salami offer, and the firm's tendency to persist with invested, strategically consistent launches makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
